title: A vanishing range and an S2 statement for the relative dualizing complex over a Cohen-Macaulay base
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file dualizing.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement gives, for a finite type map of Noetherian rings over a Cohen-Macaulay local base, a lower bound on the degrees in which the relative dualizing complex can be nonzero in terms of the transcendence degree of the fibres, and shows that the lowest surviving cohomology module is S2 (author lemma at source lines 5348-5363, label lemma-relative-dualizing-CM-vanishing). The proof (source lines 5365-5430) reduces to a local Cohen-Macaulay base by localization and completion, rewrites the relative complex through a normalized dualizing complex of the base, bounds the dimension of the localized source by the dimension formula, reads the vanishing range off the degree confinement statement, and obtains the S2 statement from the S2 property of the lowest cohomology of the normalized shriek (proof lines 5409-5429). The reduction to the normalized local situation is the substance. H3.
